article.headroomRatio: Historical headroom relative to the largest supplier
article.casePrinted: Example supplier’s latest value, previous peak and contribution to historical headroom
article.rankScope: The change is the gap between the highest and lowest rank for products with results in every ranking in this group.
article.reasonTop: The largest supplier’s share triggers this level.
article.reasonLow: Both indicators are below the medium cutoffs.
article.headsYears: Years available for the headroom calculation
article.hhiExplain: Divide each value by the total and square the percentage. Add the result for each of the three named suppliers and the combined contribution of the remaining partners.
article.exampleRounding: Import values and shares are rounded for display. The calculation uses the underlying figures.
article.scenarioExplain: Multiply the remaining value by each assumed increase. Divide by the value from the largest supplier and cap coverage at 100%.
article.headroomExplain: Add all positive differences from the other supplier countries’ peaks. Divide by the value from the largest supplier and cap the result at 100%.
article.ties: Tied products share the average of their ranks. The 100% cap can create ties as the assumed growth rises.
product.riskReasonLow: Imports are spread across supplier countries.
product.listPendingAnswer: We have no approved document match for this group.
product.listEvidence: A published match will include the exact item, dated document and page.
product.headroomNote: The percentage compares the combined headroom with the latest import value from the leading country. Values are in each year’s US dollars.
article.otherGaps: Sum of positive differences from all other countries in the calculation
article.forecastFlag: The result is an illustration under stated assumptions, not a forecast.
